string.text:
Furniture lets you build a hideout with storage, a workbench, lights, doors and decorations. 

%c[255,170,220,255]Placement%c[255,230,224,211] 
Select “Place” in the item's inventory context menu. Some doors offer left and right variants. A translucent preview and its bounding outline will appear. 
Aim at the desired location. Placement is allowed up to 15 metres away. In simple mode, the object follows the camera. Press %c[255,255,190,90][$$ACTION_use$$]%c[255,230,224,211], your interaction key, to place it. Cancelling keeps the item in your inventory. 

%c[255,170,220,255]Basic controls%c[255,230,224,211] 
These are the default editor bindings. Placement hints also show the current controls. 

%c[255,255,190,90]RMB + mouse movement%c[255,230,224,211] — rotate the object while the camera is locked. 
%c[255,255,190,90]LMB + mouse movement%c[255,230,224,211] — move the object along a plane. 
%c[255,255,190,90]Shift + LMB + mouse movement%c[255,230,224,211] — change its height. 
In advanced mode, hold %c[255,255,190,90]Ctrl%c[255,230,224,211] while moving or rotating for ten times finer control. 
%c[255,255,190,90]R%c[255,230,224,211] — switch between vertical and side rotation axes, then hold RMB and move the mouse. The side axis lets you tilt or flip the object upside down. Both angles are retained when switching; available in modes 1 and 2. 
%c[255,255,190,90]Q%c[255,230,224,211] — cycle display styles: lines with a translucent object; lines with an opaque object; an opaque object without lines. Available in all three modes. The selected view is retained when closing and reopening the editor until you exit the game. 
%c[255,255,190,90]Tab%c[255,230,224,211] — toggle collision checks. 
%c[255,255,190,90]CapsLock%c[255,230,224,211] — toggle surface alignment. 
%c[255,255,190,90]1%c[255,230,224,211] — simple mode; %c[255,255,190,90]2%c[255,230,224,211] — advanced mode; %c[255,255,190,90]3%c[255,230,224,211] — preview. 
%c[255,255,190,90]Esc%c[255,230,224,211] — undo the current drag, or cancel placement when not dragging. 

%c[255,170,220,255]Advanced mode%c[255,230,224,211] 
The object stays in place for precise adjustment. %c[255,255,190,90]Alt + LMB%c[255,230,224,211] constrains movement to one axis; %c[255,255,190,90]Alt + RMB%c[255,230,224,211] rotates in 15-degree steps. 

%c[255,170,220,255]Preview%c[255,230,224,211]
Press %c[255,255,190,90]3%c[255,230,224,211] to freeze the object position and rotation. Walk around it and inspect it from any side. Press %c[255,255,190,90][$$ACTION_use$$]%c[255,230,224,211] to place it.
Press %c[255,255,190,90]2%c[255,230,224,211] to resume precise editing at the same position and rotation. After walking around the object, drag directions follow your current view so the mouse does not feel reversed. Press %c[255,255,190,90]1%c[255,230,224,211] to reset the offsets and rotation and follow the camera again.

%c[255,170,220,255]Using placed furniture%c[255,230,224,211] 
Aim at the object and briefly press %c[255,255,190,90][$$ACTION_use$$]%c[255,230,224,211]. Storage opens for searching, the workbench opens its interface, lights toggle, and doors open or close. Decorations have no ordinary interaction. 

%c[255,170,220,255]Picking up furniture%c[255,230,224,211] 
Aim at the placed object and hold %c[255,255,190,90][$$ACTION_use$$]%c[255,230,224,211] for %c[255,255,190,90]1.4 seconds%c[255,230,224,211]. A countdown appears after a short delay. When it ends, the object returns to your inventory. Releasing the key early cancels pickup. 
Empty a storage container before picking it up.
